title: Mental Health Crisis: Screening or Not?
summary: Deciding on a screening transport under N.J.S.A. 30:4-27.6.

danger.q: Is anyone in immediate danger right now?

points: Use time, distance and cover; request backup and EMS.
Follow the AG Use of Force Policy.
Once safe, continue to the screening decision.

grounds.q: Are there reasonable grounds to believe the person is dangerous to self, others or property because of mental illness?
grounds.help: Based on what you observe or on a screener's certificate.

points: Take the person into custody for screening (30:4-27.6).
Pat down for weapons before transport.
Document the specific behavior and statements.
Offer voluntary evaluation or a crisis team.
Document the contact and any referrals.

note: Follow your department's policy and current AG directives. Not yet verified against official sources.
